analyst_view.overall: Promoted Le Mans (13th, 11 points) host Lille (3rd, 21 points, the fewest goals conceded in the league) on Saturday evening. Davide Ancelotti's Lille beat Bayern Munich 2-1 in the Champions League on Wednesday, three days before this game, so some rotation is likely; striker Ayase Ueda scored in that game, so the earlier report of him being out was wrong. Lille are without Tiago Santos (season), Hamza Igamane and Tanguy Nianzou, and Le Mans miss Sidibe and Bourabaa, with Colas and Yohou doubtful per one report; the numbers already take about 16% off Le Mans' goals for Bourabaa and some off Lille for Santos. Le Mans come in after a 3-2 comeback win at Marseille but have conceded in all eleven league games. Mathieu Vernice referees, a strict one at 4.5 cards a game, and the numbers already add about 20% for him; I lean only slightly lower on Lille's attack for the Bayern game.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals, 1.4 of them for Lille, and they already take off Santos and Le Mans' Bourabaa. Ueda is fit after scoring against Bayern, so my earlier reason for going lower is gone, but a changed Lille side three days after a big Champions League night may be a bit less sharp, so I lean slightly lower, 2.2 to about 2.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.3 corners. Both sides win few corners (Le Mans about 3.2 a game, Lille 3.9), which is already in their ratings, and Le Mans' wing-back system with Calodat and Buades is how they have played all season, so I stay at about 8.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards, already raised about 20% for referee Mathieu Vernice (4.5 a game) and trimmed because Lille have drawn and given few cards lately. Le Mans have been booked often (17 in six), which is counted too, and there is no rivalry, so I stay at about 5.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.3 shots and already take some off for Lille's quieter recent run (66 shots in six). Rotation after Bayern is likely (Lille have kept 73% of their XI over six games), so I lean slightly lower, 23.3 to about 22.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.2 shots on target, 4.4 of them for Lille. Ueda leads the line, but tired legs or a changed supporting cast after Bayern should make Lille a little less clinical than usual, so I lean slightly lower, 8.2 to about 8.0.
